buildGuidelines: Build should be relatively straightforward so as not to upstage the main character
No permanent bonuses like Auntie Ethel boon, conventional gear only
Respects developers' vision for the character
No respecs to change starting skills and abilities
Multiclassing used sparingly and only if it makes sense
Effective enough to feel useful on any difficulty

builds.name: Shadowheart
builds.description: A Spirit Guardians-focused Cleric build. Uses Concentration on Spirit Guardians for massive damage to nearby enemies. Hellrider's Pride and The Whispering Promise provide free Bless and Blade Ward to allies on heals. Mirror Image from Trickery Domain provides strong defense.

feats.name: Ability Improvement
feats.notes: Maximize medium armour effectiveness and make offensive spells harder to avoid

feats.name: Resilient
feats.notes: Gain Proficiency in Constitution Saving Throws for Concentration

feats.name: Ability Improvement
feats.notes: Help melee attacks and round Constitution to 16

weapon.name: The Blood of Lathander
weapon.location: Act 1 - Find the Blood of Lathander quest in Crèche Y'llek
weapon.notes: Legendary +3 mace. Light blinds fiends and undead. Essential for Act 2 undead encounters.

handwear.name: Hellrider's Pride
handwear.notes: Healing allies gives them Blade Ward for 2 turns (resistance to physical damage)

armour.name: Dark Justiciar Half-Plate
armour.location: Act 2 - Gauntlet of Shar (Rare) or kill Nightsong (Very Rare)
armour.notes: Provides Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws

headwear.name: Helmet of Arcane Acuity
headwear.notes: Bonuses to spell attack rolls and DC on melee hits

headwear.name: Wapira's Crown
headwear.notes: Heals Shadowheart when she heals party members

cloak.name: Vivacious Cloak
cloak.notes: 8 temporary HP when casting a spell in melee range

footwear.name: Boots of Striding
footwear.location: Act 1 - Kill Minthara at Goblin Camp
footwear.notes: Movement speed boost on Concentration spells, can't be pushed or knocked down while concentrating

footwear.name: Evasive Shoes
footwear.location: Act 2 - Mattis at Last Light Inn
footwear.notes: AC bonus alternative if you don't kill Minthara

amulet.name: Amulet of Restoration
amulet.location: Act 1 - Derryth Bonecloak, Myconid Colony, Underdark

amulet.name: Amulet of the Devout
amulet.notes: Late-game option, makes spells harder to resist

rings.name: The Whispering Promise
rings.location: Act 1 - Volo or Grat the Trader, Goblin Camp
rings.notes: Source of free Bless when healing - crucial part of the build

rings.name: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
rings.notes: Cast Illusion or Enchantment spell as Bonus Action after landing melee attack

gameplan.core: Boost Constitution Saving Throws, upcast Spirit Guardians, and wade into the fray. Deals massive damage to nearby enemies, and with Blood of Lathander, fiends and undead also get Blinded.
gameplan.healing: Use Hellrider's Pride and The Whispering Promise to give allies Bless and Blade Ward whenever healing. Mass Healing Word costs only a Bonus Action and doesn't need Concentration, allowing buffing the entire team while doing something else.
gameplan.summoning: Spiritual Weapon and Planar Ally are strong summoning options.
nonConcentration: Sanctuary (prevents all damage, Bonus Action, no Concentration)
Warding Bond (make ally sturdier, no Concentration)
alternatives: Shield of Faith for tanking strong foes
Silence to shut down enemy spellcasters
